canonical_statement: A source-selected mathematical theorem about a heat equation; repository metadata currently supplies only the PDE/model name, so the precise proposition is not yet frozen.
domain_and_universes: A time interval and spatial domain, plausibly in finite-dimensional real Euclidean space; domain geometry and scalar/codomain choices remain open.
hypotheses: initial and boundary compatibility assumptions required by the selected claim
conclusion: The exact source-selected proposition about solutions of the heat equation; no conclusion is inferred from the equation name alone.

alternate_encodings.target: partial_t u - div(A grad u) = f

alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate encoding requiring checked equivalence under regularity

excluded_degenerate_cases: Do not turn the PDE definition into a tautology, silently select dimension one, omit required initial/boundary data, or substitute the separately indexed fundamental-solution or maximum-principle theorems.
foundation_profile: Classical multivariable calculus, functional analysis, and PDE foundations expected; exact classical/choice/quotient profile open
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib dependency closure; exact versions and imports open
computation_profile: No numerical simulation, oracle, or empirical observation is credited as theorem evidence
source_revisions: Discovery leads are listed in source-statement-crosswalk.md; immutable editions, pinpoint claims, assumptions, translations, and errata remain open.
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the selected source claim, equation variant, domains/data/solution notion, Lean target, dependency pins, foundation/TCB policy, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: This intake identifies an under-specified equation/model record. It does not freeze, prove, or validate a Lean theorem or the empirical heat-conduction model.
